items.prompt: Which animation builds an object by drawing its stroke?
items.explanation: Create draws the stroke onto the screen. FadeIn reveals without drawing; Indicate only draws attention; Transform morphs one object into another.

items.prompt: Why prefer TransformMatchingTex when changing one equation into another?
options: It shows which terms persist across the change.
It renders faster than any other animation.
items.explanation: TransformMatchingTex matches shared TeX fragments so the viewer sees continuity between the two equations — the relationship is the lesson.

items.prompt: Which rate function makes a motion emphasise a point and then return to the start?
items.explanation: there_and_back moves to the target and back, ideal for a passing emphasis. linear is constant speed; smooth eases in and out but does not return.

items.prompt: After this runs, what colour is sq?
items.explanation: sq is added first, then .animate.set_color(RED) animates the change. After play, sq is RED. Without self.add it would not be visible.

items.prompt: Find the broken line and choose the fix.
items.explanation: Line 2 drives two competing .animate calls on the same mobject in one play. Chain them into a single coherent state change: sq.animate.shift(RIGHT).set_color(RED).

items.prompt: Which are correct uses of composition / attention animations? (Select all.)
options: LaggedStart to stagger a sequence of appearances.
Indicate to draw attention without changing the model.
Competing .animate calls on one property in one play call.
items.explanation: The first three are correct composition/attention uses. Competing .animate calls on one property are a bug — chain them instead.

items.prompt: Write a scene that creates a shape, transforms it into a different shape, and emphasises the result with there_and_back. Pause after each beat.
items.modelAnswer:
from manim import *

class TransformEmphasis(Scene):
    def construct(self):
        self.camera.background_color = "#1C1C1C"
        sq = Square(side_length=1.5, color=BLUE)
        self.play(Create(sq), run_time=1.0)
        self.wait(0.8)
        self.play(Transform(sq, Circle(radius=0.9, color=BLUE)), run_time=1.5)
        self.wait(1.0)
        self.play(sq.animate.scale(1.1), rate_func=there_and_back, run_time=1.0)
        self.wait(1.0)
        self.play(FadeOut(Group(*self.mobjects)), run_time=0.6)

rubric.criterion: Creates a shape, then transforms it into another.
Uses there_and_back for the emphasis beat.
Mobject created before any property animation.

items.explanation: The model chains create -> transform -> emphasise, with a pause after each beat and a Group cleanup.
